list.name: repository
list.label: Repository
list.query: SELECT repository FROM repos WHERE ('${visibility}'='All' OR visibility='${visibility}') AND ('${fork}'='All' OR is_fork='${fork}') AND ('${archived}'='All' OR is_archived='${archived}') ORDER BY repository

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(count) AS "Total views" FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='views' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring})
targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(count) AS "Total views" FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='views' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring})

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(uniques) AS "Unique visitors" FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='views' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring})
targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(uniques) AS "Unique visitors" FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='views' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring})

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(count) AS "Total clones" FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='clones' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring})
targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(count) AS "Total clones" FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='clones' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring})

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(uniques) AS "Unique cloners" FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='clones' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring})
targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(uniques) AS "Unique cloners" FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='clones' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring})

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%s', day) AS time, SUM(count) AS "Views", SUM(uniques) AS "Unique visitors" FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='views' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%s', day) AS time, SUM(count) AS "Views", SUM(uniques) AS "Unique visitors" FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='views' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%s', day) AS time, SUM(count) AS "Clones", SUM(uniques) AS "Unique cloners" FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='clones' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%s', day) AS time, SUM(count) AS "Clones", SUM(uniques) AS "Unique cloners" FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='clones' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

panels.title: Detailed per-repository views (optional — expand to load)
Views by repository (one line per repo)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%s', day) AS time, repository, SUM(count) AS views FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='views' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) GROUP BY day, repository ORDER BY day
targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%s', day) AS time, repository, SUM(count) AS views FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='views' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) GROUP BY day, repository ORDER BY day

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT source AS "Referring site", SUM(count) AS "Views", SUM(uniques) AS "Unique visitors" FROM referrers WHERE repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM referrers r2 WHERE r2.repository = referrers.repository) GROUP BY source ORDER BY "Views" DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT source AS "Referring site", SUM(count) AS "Views", SUM(uniques) AS "Unique visitors" FROM referrers WHERE repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM referrers r2 WHERE r2.repository = referrers.repository) GROUP BY source ORDER BY "Views" DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(title,''), path) AS "Content", path AS "Path", SUM(count) AS "Views", SUM(uniques) AS "Unique visitors" FROM popular_paths WHERE repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM popular_paths p2 WHERE p2.repository = popular_paths.repository) GROUP BY path ORDER BY "Views" DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(title,''), path) AS "Content", path AS "Path", SUM(count) AS "Views", SUM(uniques) AS "Unique visitors" FROM popular_paths WHERE repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) AND day = (SELECT MAX(day) FROM popular_paths p2 WHERE p2.repository = popular_paths.repository) GROUP BY path ORDER BY "Views" DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT repository AS "Repository", SUM(CASE WHEN metric='views' THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS "Views", SUM(CASE WHEN metric='views' THEN uniques ELSE 0 END) AS "Unique visitors", SUM(CASE WHEN metric='clones' THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS "Clones" FROM traffic_daily WHERE repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) GROUP BY repository ORDER BY "Views" DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT repository AS "Repository", SUM(CASE WHEN metric='views' THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS "Views", SUM(CASE WHEN metric='views' THEN uniques ELSE 0 END) AS "Unique visitors", SUM(CASE WHEN metric='clones' THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS "Clones" FROM traffic_daily WHERE repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) GROUP BY repository ORDER BY "Views" DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT repository AS "Repository", SUM(CASE WHEN day >= date('now','-7 day') THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS "Last 7d", SUM(CASE WHEN day < date('now','-7 day') AND day >= date('now','-14 day') THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS "Prior 7d", SUM(CASE WHEN day >= date('now','-7 day') THEN count ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN day < date('now','-7 day') AND day >= date('now','-14 day') THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS "Change" FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='views' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) GROUP BY repository ORDER BY "Change" DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT repository AS "Repository", SUM(CASE WHEN day >= date('now','-7 day') THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS "Last 7d", SUM(CASE WHEN day < date('now','-7 day') AND day >= date('now','-14 day') THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS "Prior 7d", SUM(CASE WHEN day >= date('now','-7 day') THEN count ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN day < date('now','-7 day') AND day >= date('now','-14 day') THEN count ELSE 0 END) AS "Change" FROM traffic_daily WHERE metric='views' AND repository IN (${repository:sqlstring}) GROUP BY repository ORDER BY "Change" DESC
